display.title: See how your interests can become a university programme
display.intro: Start with a set of interests. Then see different ways those interests could translate into a degree: a representative disciplinary programme and three possible UCR programmes, moving from greater disciplinary depth toward broader interdisciplinary combinations.
display.examplesIntro: Each example starts from one prospective student's interests and shows several academically coherent ways of developing them.

examples.title: Economics, politics, and why some countries become rich while others stay poor
examples.description: Compare a representative disciplinary programme with three ways of combining these interests at UCR.
